Neuronal/Glial lineage development

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(stringi)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

library(Seurat)
library(ggrepel)
```



# 1. Trajectory analysis
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")
```

## (1) neuronal lineage
```{r}
set.seed(100)
addArchRThreads(8)

# prepare UMAP ~ 30s
ArchR_lineage_neuro <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region)){
  print(x)
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]] <- ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region == x & ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0 %in% 
                                              c("Neuron", "Neuroblast", "Neuronal IPC", "Radial glia"),]
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]@projectMetadata@listData[["outputDirectory"]] <- "./ArchR_lineage/Neuronal"
  
  # add UMAP
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]] <- addUMAP(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], reducedDims = "Harmony_age",name = "UMAP_neuro", 
                                      nNeighbors = 30, minDist = 0.5, metric = "cosine", force = TRUE)
  
  # save UMAP plots
  plotPDF(plotEmbedding(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Age", 
                        embedding = "UMAP_neuro",  labelMeans=FALSE,
                        pal = c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452", CS21="#f2de5c")),
          name = paste0("neuro_UMAP_",x,"_Age.pdf"), 
          ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], addDOC = FALSE, width = 6, height = 6)
  plotPDF(plotEmbedding(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], colorBy = "cellColData", name = "ctAnnot_2.0", 
                        embedding = "UMAP_neuro",  labelMeans=FALSE,
                        pal = c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff", "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 
                                'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")), 
          name = paste0("neuro_UMAP_",x,"_ct.pdf"), 
          ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], addDOC = FALSE, width = 6, height = 6)
  rm(x)
}
```

### main fig - trajectory UMAP
```{r}
set.seed(100)

# compute trajectory, split early/late stages
p <- list()
i <- 1
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)){
  ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage <- stri_replace_all_regex(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Age, vectorise_all = FALSE,
                                          pattern = c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"),
                                          replacement = paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Early","Late","Late","Late")))
  for (y in unique(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage)){
    # keep only cells in the given stage
    ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Traj_label <- NA
    ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Traj_label[ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage==y] <-
      ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$ctAnnot_2.0[ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$Stage==y]

    # add a trajectory for the given stage on the shared UMAP
    ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]] <- addTrajectory(ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y,
                                              groupBy = "Traj_label", reducedDims = "Harmony_age",
                                 trajectory = c("Radial glia","Neuronal IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"), embedding = "UMAP_neuro",
                                 preFilterQuantile = 0.98, postFilterQuantile = 0.98, force = TRUE, spar = 1.5)
    p[[i]] <- plotTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], embedding = "UMAP_neuro", trajectory = y, colorBy = "cellColData", name = y,
                             plotAs = "points", continuousSet = "solarExtra")
    i <- i+1
  }
}
rm(i, x, y)

# saving PDF
pdf("./ArchR_lineage/Neuronal/Plots/neuro_trajectory_all.pdf", width = 3, height = 3.6)
p[[1]][[1]]
p[[2]][[1]]
p[[3]][[1]]
p[[4]][[1]]
p[[5]][[1]]
p[[6]][[1]]
dev.off()
```

### main fig - pseudotime bins
```{r}
# sanity check: cell type labels along pseudotime
subtype <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)){
  for (y in paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Late"))){
    # pseudotime bins
    pseudotime <- data.frame(cellID = getCellNames(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]), 
                             pseudotime = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]@cellColData@listData[[y]],
                             celltype = ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]$ctAnnot_2.0)
    pseudotime <- na.omit(pseudotime)
    pseudotime$bin <- pmin(floor(pseudotime$pseudotime) + 1, 100)
      
    # avg cell type for each pseudotime bin 
    subtype[[y]] <- data.frame()
    for(z in 1:100){
      subtype[[y]] <- rbind(subtype[[y]], c(z, names(which.max(table(pseudotime$celltype[pseudotime$bin==z])))))
    }
    names(subtype[[y]]) <- c("bin","celltype")
    subtype[[y]]$bin <- as.numeric(subtype[[y]]$bin)
  }
  rm(x, y, z, pseudotime)
}
names(subtype) <- stri_replace_all_regex(names(subtype), pattern = c("Forebrain","Medulla","CerebellumPons"), 
                                         replacement = c("FB","MD","CP"), vectorize_all = FALSE)

# plot cell types
p <- list()
for (x in names(subtype)){
  p[[x]] <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label = sub("_"," ",x), size = 3.5) + theme_void() +
    ggplot(subtype[[x]], aes(x=bin, y=0, fill=celltype)) + geom_tile() + 
    theme_void() + scale_fill_manual(values = c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff", "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 
                                                'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0"), name = "Cell type") +
    #coord_fixed(ratio = 10) + 
    plot_layout(widths = c(1.08,4)) 
}
for (x in 1:5){
  p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# add pseudotime scale
p[[7]] <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label=" ", size = 3.5) + theme_void() +
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0, y=0, label="") + theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.line.x = element_line(),  axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  xlab("pseudotime") + xlim(0,100) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1,4))
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=2, dpi=300}
wrap_plots(p, ncol=1) + plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1,1,1,1,1,1,0))
```

# 2. TF activity
## (1) ct-region-specific TF
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script7/ArchR_lineage_neuro.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script7/ArchR_lineage_glial.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script3/heatmap_summary_ctRegion.rda")

# get ct-region-specific TFs from Script3
TF_select <- unique(heatmap_summary_ctRegion$gene)
TF_select <- as.vector(TF_select)
```


## (2) supp - glial lineage
```{r}
# select TFs (ct-rg-spc from script3) that have correlated gene score and motif chromVAR z score ~ 1.5 min
heatmap <- list()
for (x in c("CerebellumPons","Medulla")){
  for (y in paste0(x, "_Late")){
    print(y)
    
    # get gene score and chromVAR trend using pseudotime bins
    trajMotif  <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_glial[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", 
                                log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    trajGeneScore <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_glial[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                                   log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    
    # correlation for all TFs
    cor <- correlateTrajectories(trajGeneScore, trajMotif)
    cor <- cor[["allMappings"]][! grepl("deviations",cor[["allMappings"]]$name2),]
    cor$group <- y
    cor <- as.data.frame(cor)
    
    # significant correlations
    ## significance cutoff: FDR < 0.01, correlation >=0.5
    ## biological cutoff: top 20% variable features - VarAssay1 >= 0.8 , VarAssay2 >=0.8
    trajCor_sig <- cor[cor$FDR <= 0.01 & cor$Correlation >=0.5 & cor$VarAssay1 >= 0.8 & cor$VarAssay2 >= 0.8,]
    trajCor_fil <- trajCor_sig[trajCor_sig$matchname1 %in% TF_select,]
    trajGeneScore <- trajGeneScore[trajCor_fil$name1, ]
    trajMotif <- trajMotif[trajCor_fil$name2, ]
    
    # combined
    trajCombined <- trajGeneScore
    assay(trajCombined, withDimnames=FALSE) <- t(apply(assay(trajGeneScore), 1, scale)) + t(apply(assay(trajMotif), 1, scale))
    combinedMat <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajCombined, returnMat = TRUE, varCutOff = 0)
    rowOrder <- match(rownames(combinedMat), rownames(trajGeneScore))
    
    # fix gene names
    trajGeneScore@NAMES <- sub(".*:","",trajGeneScore@NAMES)
    trajMotif@NAMES <- NULL
    
    # plotting
    heatmap[[y]] <- list()
    heatmap[[y]][[1]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajGeneScore,  pal = c("#704D9E", "#BC5AA9", "#ED7C97", "#f79452", "#f2de5c"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, labelRows = TRUE, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = c("Radial glia"="#836dff","Glioblast"="#c47df0"))
    heatmap[[y]][[2]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMotif,  pal = paletteContinuous(set = "whitePurple"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = c("Radial glia"="#836dff","Glioblast"="#c47df0"))
    heatmap[[y]][[2]]@ht_list[["MotifMatrix"]]@top_annotation@anno_list[["label"]]@label <- ""
  }
  rm(x, y, cor, trajCor_sig, trajCor_fil, trajGeneScore, trajMotif, trajCombined, combinedMat, rowOrder)
}
```

```{r}
p <- heatmap[["CerebellumPons_Late"]][[2]] + heatmap[["CerebellumPons_Late"]][[1]]
draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, gap = unit(-2, "mm"), heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
```

```{r}
p <- heatmap[["Medulla_Late"]][[2]] + heatmap[["Medulla_Late"]][[1]]
draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE, gap = unit(-2, "mm"))
```



## (3) main & supp - neuronal lineage
```{r}
# select TFs (ct-rg-spc from script3) that have correlated gene score and motif chromVAR z score ~ 4 min for 3 regions
heatmap <- list()
colours <- c(Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff", "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff")
for (x in "Forebrain"){  # for supp figures: names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)
  for (y in paste0(x, "_", c("Early","Late"))){
    print(y)
    
    # get gene score and chromVAR trend using pseudotime bins
    trajMotif  <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", 
                                log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    trajGeneScore <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                                   log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    
    # correlation for all TFs
    cor <- correlateTrajectories(trajGeneScore, trajMotif)
    cor <- cor[["allMappings"]][! grepl("deviations",cor[["allMappings"]]$name2),]
    cor$group <- y
    cor <- as.data.frame(cor)
    
    # significant correlations
    ## significance cutoff: FDR < 0.01, correlation >=0.4
    ## biological cutoff: top 20% variable features - VarAssay1 >= 0.8 , VarAssay2 >=0.8
    trajCor_sig <- cor[cor$FDR <= 0.01 & cor$Correlation >=0.5 & cor$VarAssay1 >= 0.8 & cor$VarAssay2 >= 0.8,]
    trajCor_fil <- trajCor_sig[trajCor_sig$matchname1 %in% TF_select,]
    trajGeneScore <- trajGeneScore[trajCor_fil$name1, ]
    trajMotif <- trajMotif[trajCor_fil$name2, ]
    
    # combined
    trajCombined <- trajGeneScore
    assay(trajCombined, withDimnames=FALSE) <- t(apply(assay(trajGeneScore), 1, scale)) + t(apply(assay(trajMotif), 1, scale))
    combinedMat <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajCombined, returnMat = TRUE, varCutOff = 0)
    rowOrder <- match(rownames(combinedMat), rownames(trajGeneScore))
    
    # fix gene names
    trajGeneScore@NAMES <- sub(".*:","",trajGeneScore@NAMES)
    trajMotif@NAMES <- NULL
    
    # plotting
    heatmap[[y]] <- list()
    heatmap[[y]][[1]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajGeneScore,  pal = c("#704D9E", "#BC5AA9", "#ED7C97", "#f79452", "#f2de5c"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, labelRows = TRUE, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = colours[unique(trajGeneScore@colData@listData[["label"]])])
    heatmap[[y]][[2]] <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMotif,  pal = paletteContinuous(set = "whitePurple"),  
                                             rowOrder = rowOrder, colorColumns = TRUE, 
                                             columnPal = colours[unique(trajMotif@colData@listData[["label"]])])
    heatmap[[y]][[1]]@ht_list[["GeneScoreMatrix"]]@top_annotation@anno_list[["label"]]@label <- ""
    heatmap[[y]][[2]]@ht_list[["MotifMatrix"]]@top_annotation@anno_list[["label"]]@label <- ""
  }
  rm(x, y, cor, trajCor_sig, trajCor_fil, trajGeneScore, trajMotif, trajCombined, combinedMat, rowOrder)
}
```

## (1) TRS ~ chromVAR: neuro
```{r}
# align TRS and chromVAR to pseudotime, compute odds ratio and correlation ~ 50s
TRS_summary_neuro <- list()
correlation_summary_neuro <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_neuro)){
  for (y in paste0(x,"_",c("Early","Late"))){
    
    print(y)
    TRS_summary_neuro[[y]] <- data.frame()
    correlation_summary_neuro[[y]] <- data.frame()
    trajMotif  <- getTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]], name = y, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", 
                                log2Norm = FALSE, trajectoryLabel = "ctAnnot_2.0")
    trajMotif <- as.data.frame(t(assay(trajMotif)))
    trajMotif <- trajMotif[,grepl("z:",names(trajMotif))] # keep only the deviation z score (raw deviation score affected by read depth)
    
    for (z in names(mono_mat_permu_ct)){
      print(z)
      
      # get TRS and pseudotime for cells in this trajectory
      TRS <- mono_mat_permu_ct[[z]][,c("names","TRS","true_cell_top_idx")]
      TRS <- TRS[getCellNames(ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]),]
      TRS$pseudotime <- ArchR_lineage_neuro[[x]]@cellColData@listData[[y]]
      TRS <- na.omit(TRS)
      
      # average TRS per pseudotime bin (bin size = 1)
      TRS$bin <- pmin(floor(TRS$pseudotime) + 1, 100)
      TRS_temp <- data.frame()
      for(i in 1:100){
        TRS_temp <- rbind(TRS_temp, c(z, i, mean(TRS$TRS[TRS$bin==i])))
      }
      names(TRS_temp) <- c("condition", "bin","TRS")
      TRS_temp$TRS <- as.numeric(TRS_temp$TRS)
      
      # odds ratio and p-value per pseudotime bin (bin size = 1)
      sig_summary <- data.frame()
      for(i in 1:100){
        sig_summary <- rbind(sig_summary, c(i, sum(TRS$bin==i & TRS$true_cell_top_idx==TRUE), sum(TRS$bin==i)))
      }
      names(sig_summary) <- c("bin","sigCells","allCells")
      sig_summary$odds_ratio <- (sig_summary$sigCells / (sig_summary$allCells - sig_summary$sigCells)) /
        ((sum(sig_summary$sigCells) - sig_summary$sigCells) / 
           (sum(sig_summary$allCells) - sum(sig_summary$sigCells) - (sig_summary$allCells - sig_summary$sigCells)))
      TRS_temp$odds_ratio <- sig_summary$odds_ratio
      TRS_summary_neuro[[y]] <- rbind(TRS_summary_neuro[[y]], TRS_temp)
        
      # correlation: TRS ~ chromVAR
      cor <- data.frame()
      for (tf in names(trajMotif)){
        out <- cor.test(trajMotif[[tf]], TRS_temp$TRS, method = "spearman",exact = FALSE)
        cor <- rbind(cor, data.frame(condition = z, TF = tf, p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate))
      }
      cor$FDR <- p.adjust(cor$p_value, method = "BH")
      correlation_summary_neuro[[y]] <- rbind(correlation_summary_neuro[[y]], cor)
    }
  }
}
rm(x,y,z,i, TRS,TRS_temp, sig_summary, trajMotif,out,tf)
```

### setup for pySCENIC
Preparation: use existing resources from *script6_SCENIC*
```{bash}
cd Downloads/P1_EHB/data_output/script7_SCENIC
conda activate pyscenic
python
```

```{python}
import os
import glob
import pickle
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from dask.diagnostics import ProgressBar
from arboreto.utils import load_tf_names
from arboreto.algo import grnboost2
from ctxcore.rnkdb import FeatherRankingDatabase as RankingDatabase
from pkg_resources import DistributionNotFound, get_distribution
from pyscenic.utils import modules_from_adjacencies, load_motifs
from pyscenic.prune import prune2df, df2regulons
from pyscenic.aucell import aucell
```

```{python}
# load expression data
ex_matrix = pd.read_csv("./data/Eze_counts_all.txt", sep='\t', header=0, index_col=0)
ex_matrix # 18461 cells, 8233 genes

# load known TFs
tf_names = load_tf_names("../Script6_SCENIC/resources/allTFs_hg38.txt")
tf_names[:5]

# load ranking database (feather data)
db_fnames = glob.glob("../Script6_SCENIC/databases/hg38_10kbp_up_10kbp_down_full_tx_v10_clust.genes_vs_motifs.rankings.feather")
def name(fname): 
  return os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(fname))[0] # run by itself

dbs = [RankingDatabase(fname=fname, name=name(fname)) for fname in db_fnames]
dbs
```

```{python}
# genes in expression matrix that overlap with feather files
genes_overlap = set(ex_matrix.columns) & set(dbs[0].genes)
len(genes_overlap) # 8204 overlapping genes

# filter expression matrix
ex_matrix_fil = ex_matrix.loc[:, ex_matrix.columns.isin(genes_overlap)]
ex_matrix_fil # 18461 cells x 8204 genes
```


### run pySCENIC
```{python}
# calculate co-expression modules: CPU-intensive ~ 24 min
import time
start = time.time()
adjacencies = grnboost2(ex_matrix_fil, tf_names=tf_names, verbose=True) # if matrix too large, fails within 0.1 sec
elapsed = (time.time() - start) / 60
print(f"{elapsed:.2f}")

# add TFs to modules, keeping modules with > 20 genes
modules = list(modules_from_adjacencies(adjacencies, ex_matrix))
len(modules) # 5089 gene modules identified

# number of genes in each module
pd.DataFrame({"TF": [m.name for m in modules], "n_genes": [len(m.genes) for m in modules]})

# save modules
import pickle
with open("./data/modules.pkl", "wb") as f: pickle.dump(modules, f)
```

```{python}
# find enriched motifs and their target genes for each module ~ 5 min
with ProgressBar(): 
  df = prune2df(dbs, modules, "../Script6_SCENIC/resources/motifs-v10nr_clust-nr.hgnc-m0.001-o0.0.tbl", filter_for_annotation=False)
df.to_csv("./data/motifs_noFil.csv")

# create regulons from enriched motifs
regulons = df2regulons(df)
len(regulons) # 883 regulons (no filtering)

# save the regulons
with open("./data/regulons_noFil.p", "wb") as f: pickle.dump(regulons, f) # compatible with python only
rows = []
for reg in regulons:
    for gene, weight in reg.gene2weight.items():
        rows.append([reg.name, gene, weight])
pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["TF","TargetGene","Weight"]).to_csv("data/regulons_noFil.csv", index=False) # compatible with R
```

```{r}
correlation_summary_AUC <- list()
for (x in c("Forebrain_Early","Forebrain_Late")){
  print(x)
  correlation_summary_AUC[[x]] <- data.frame()
  
  # get pseudotime bins
  pseudotime <- data.frame(cell = getCellNames(ArchR_lineage_neuro[["Forebrain"]]),
                           pseudotime = ArchR_lineage_neuro[["Forebrain"]]@cellColData@listData[[x]])
  pseudotime <- na.omit(pseudotime)
  pseudotime$bin <- pmin(floor(pseudotime$pseudotime) + 1, 100)
  
  # average regulon activity for each bin
  AUC_avg <- data.frame()
  for (i in 1:100){
    scenic_AUC_fil <- scenic_AUC[scenic_AUC$Cell %in% pseudotime$cell[pseudotime$bin==i],]
    AUC_avg <- rbind(AUC_avg, cbind(i, t(colMeans(scenic_AUC_fil[,2:ncol(scenic_AUC_fil)]))))
  }
  names(AUC_avg)[1] <- "pseudotime"
  AUC_summary[[x]] <- AUC_avg
    
  # correlation: TRS ~ AUC
  for (y in unique(TRS_summary_neuro[[x]]$condition)){
    cor <- data.frame()
    for (z in names(AUC_avg)[2:ncol(AUC_avg)]){
      out <- cor.test(TRS_summary_neuro[[x]]$TRS[TRS_summary_neuro[[x]]$condition==y], AUC_avg[[z]], method = "spearman",exact = FALSE) 
      cor <- rbind(cor, data.frame(condition = y, TF = z, p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate))
    }  
    cor$FDR <- p.adjust(cor$p_value, method = "BH")
    correlation_summary_AUC[[x]] <- rbind(correlation_summary_AUC[[x]], cor)
  }
}
rm(x,i,y,z, pseudotime,AUC_avg,scenic_AUC_fil,cor)
```

```{r}
save(AUC_summary, correlation_summary_AUC, file = "./data_rda/Script7/AUC_correlation.rda")
```

### main fig - overlap Venn
```{r}
# formatting results from TRS~chromVAR
validation_summary <- list()
validation_summary[["TRSxchromVAR"]] <- list()
validation_summary[["TRSxAUC"]] <- list()
validation_summary[["overlap"]] <- data.frame()
cor_TRSxchromVAR <- list()
cor_TRSxAUC <- list()
for (x in c("Forebrain_Late","Forebrain_Early")){
  
  # TRS x chromVAR
  cor1 <- correlation_summary_neuro[[x]]
  cor1$TF <- sub(".*z:","",sub("_.*","",cor1$TF))
  cor1 <- cor1[cor1$FDR <= 0.01 & cor1$coefficient >= 0.6,]
  cor_TRSxchromVAR[[x]] <- cor1
  
  # TRS x AUC
  cor2 <- correlation_summary_AUC[[x]]
  cor2 <- cor2[cor2$FDR <= 0.01 & cor2$coefficient >= 0.6,]
  cor_TRSxAUC[[x]] <- cor2
  
  for (y in interest){
    validation_summary[["TRSxchromVAR"]][[x]][[y]] <- cor1$TF[cor1$condition==y]
    validation_summary[["TRSxAUC"]][[x]][[y]] <- cor2$TF[cor2$condition==y]
    n <- length(cor1$TF[cor1$condition==y][cor1$TF[cor1$condition==y] %in% cor2$TF[cor2$condition==y]])
    validation_summary[["overlap"]] <- rbind(validation_summary[["overlap"]], c(x,y,n))
  }
}
rm(x,y,cor1,cor2,n)
save(validation_summary, file = "./data_rda/Script7/validation_summary.rda")
```

```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script7/validation_summary.rda")

p <- list()

    ls <- list(A = validation_summary[["TRSxchromVAR"]][[x]][[y]],
               B = validation_summary[["TRSxAUC"]][[x]][[y]])
    p[[paste0(x,"_",y)]] <- ggVennDiagram::ggVennDiagram(ls,  label = "count") +

}
```

### main fig - overlap TFs
```{r}
interest_overlap <- data.frame(lineage=c("Forebrain_Early","Forebrain_Late", "Forebrain_Late"), 
                               condition=c("ASD","MDD","SCZ"))

# plot correlation results for genes of interest
set.seed(100)
p <- list()
for (x in 1:nrow(interest_overlap)){
  lineage <- interest_overlap$lineage[[x]]
  condition <- interest_overlap$condition[[x]]
  
  # overlapping genes
  TF_list1 <- validation_summary[["TRSxchromVAR"]][[lineage]][[condition]]
  TF_list2 <- validation_summary[["TRSxAUC"]][[lineage]][[condition]]
  TF_overlap <- TF_list1[TF_list1 %in% TF_list2]
  
  # extract correlation results
  df1 <- cor_TRSxchromVAR[[lineage]][cor_TRSxchromVAR[[lineage]]$condition==condition & cor_TRSxchromVAR[[lineage]]$TF %in% TF_overlap,]
  df2 <- cor_TRSxAUC[[lineage]][cor_TRSxAUC[[lineage]]$condition==condition & cor_TRSxAUC[[lineage]]$TF %in% TF_overlap,]
  names(df1)[3:5] <- paste0("TRSxchromVAR","_",names(df1)[3:5])
  names(df2)[3:5] <- paste0("TRSxAUC","_",names(df2)[3:5])
  df <- merge(df1[,c(1,2,4)], df2[,c(1,2,4)], by = c("condition","TF"))
  
  p[[x]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x=TRSxchromVAR_coefficient, y=TRSxAUC_coefficient)) +
    geom_point(colour = "#039dfc") + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
    ggtitle(paste0(lineage, "_", condition)) + 
    geom_text_repel(aes(label=TF), size=2.7, min.segment.length = 0, colour = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=10), axis.text = element_text(size=9))
}
rm(x, lineage, condition, TF_list1, TF_list2, TF_overlap, df1, df2, df)
```
